# IMPORTANT DRUG PROPERTIES CODING

Next to each drug quick order in CDSS, there are letters alerting the user to

important properties associated with that drug:

[DI]= clinically important drug interactions

[H] = may require dose adjustment in patients with hepatic dysfunction

[R] = may require dose adjustment in patients with renal dysfunction

[O] = other important information

[M] = minimal

The Important Drug Properties menu contains valuable information on common or

severe adverse effects, drug interactions and dose adjustments for hepatic and

renal failure. This list is not comprehensive. Refer to Up-to-date, found in

Clinical Online Resources under the Tools menu in CPRS, or click on the ling

below for more information.

[Up-to-Date online \(Lexicomp\)](orz-gtx-abx-up-to-date)

[Sanford online](orz-gtx-abx-sanford)

Infectious Diseases and Pharmacy Services can help with dose adjustments.
